name: Operations History at Scale
summary: Keep instance replay intelligible and responsive with grouped multi-instance execution, bounded iteration discovery and exact causal drill-down at 50,000 iterations.
next_action: Merge the iteration replay window PR (OHS3 increment 2); then variable values per step and job/user-task history per iteration. Engine quadratic MI-subprocess completion is Issue #1494.

slices.title: Default grouped multi-instance history
slices.note: PR #1483 merged: grouped history is available in Operations, while legacy timeline loading remains unbounded until OHS2/OHS3.

slices.title: Bounded iteration lookup and filtering
slices.note: #1487 (keys), #1488 (projection), #1490 (fail-closed readiness) #1496 (index v2, bounded API, 50k acceptance) and #1502 (Multi-Instance Explorer, startup rebuild of older stores) merged. Index schema v2 adds loopCounter order, lifecycle-state and incident families, write-only body counters and nested-body parents; api/mihistory serves the cursor-paged, off-writer, HMAC-cursor API and MCP tools with a 50,000-iteration end-to-end acceptance. The Operations Multi-Instance Explorer and a timeline-free view for large instances are built (e2e/mi-explorer.spec.mjs). The instance outline (cfOutline, instance_outline_v1) gives the bounded view the instance's own steps (#1507, merged). Open: per-instance readiness for compacted logs, and #1494 (quadratic MI-subprocess completion). Stores that predate the index are rebuilt at startup from the retained log (accepted shadow-replay ADR draft).

slices.title: Scalable iteration detail replay
slices.note: Increment 1 (#1502, merged): one iteration's recorded scope variables and its attributed DMN decisions (cfMIDecision, own readiness marker), in the API and the explorer. Increment 2: the replay window of one iteration — the steps inside it (cfIterationStep, readiness marker mi_iteration_steps_v1, covered by the startup rebuild), a bounded route and MCP tool, and a step-by-step replay on the diagram in the explorer; 1,110 bytes / 1.2 ms for iteration 37,421 of the 50k acceptance instance. Open: variable values at each step, collapsed-subprocess planes, job/user-task history per iteration, and the retention/migration verification.
